body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds a new dictionary for the `SimTauCPLink::DecayNav` persistent object, and definitions for vectors of this latter and references to MtdSimLayerCluster.
This was spotted with the https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52201 runtime warnings encountered in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52085#issuecomment-6288900261, https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52085#issuecomment-6282114102.

#### PR validation:

Compiles and reduces dictionaries generation overhead.
title: Add missing dictionaries for CaloAnalysis
